policies.title: Eritrean ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Eritrea as Prior to Arrival, which it defines as obtaining a visa from a mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Eritrean passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Eritrean ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Eritrea in its authorized-visa cohort for advance consular approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Eritrean passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and must be granted before travel.
Washington-specific filing mechanics are not generalized to every consular district; final admission remains discretionary.
